prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1047; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while making a left turn, with a reported wrist fracture. The mechanism and force described are consistent with the injury observed on imaging and clinical assessment. Over the course of fifteen visits, treatment extended somewhat beyond what is typical for this type of fracture, reflecting a gradual recovery course with intermittent follow-up. Examination findings include localized tenderness and reduced grip strength that support the reported injury, while several other neurovascular and range-of-motion tests returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the same wrist or forearm is documented in the available history. Billing for two similar treatment charges dated the same day is currently under review to confirm they reflect separate, medically necessary services. Ongoing monitoring and a structured rehabilitation plan are recommended, with reassessment at the next scheduled visit.
